2 And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world. (1 John 2:2 KJV)

The word propitiation means atonement, so Jesus atoned for our sins by His sacrifice. The Bible tells us that propitiation means putting Jesus righteousness to our account, making us as righteous as Jesus is (Romans 3:25). What a wonderful thing it is to think that we appear to God the Father as righteous as His son Jesus. Wow, that is awesome, as when God looks at the born again believer, He sees His Son, whose spirit has come to live in us (Galatians 4:6).

Notice that Jesus didn’t just die for the sins of those who believe in Him, but He died for the sins of the whole world. That means that even the sins of the unbelievers have already been paid for (1 Timothy 4:10). Does this mean that everyone will go to Heaven – NO, as those who do not accept Jesus as their Savior, have not accepted the payment for their sins. Therefore even though the sins of the whole world have been paid for, those who do not accept Jesus will be condemned for the one sin of turning down the Son of God as their Savior, as their name will not be in the book of life (Revelation 20:15). Praise God that isn’t me.
